pkgmetadata.longdescription: copr-cli is the command line frontend of the Copr build service. It creates projects, submits and monitors builds, manages chroots and packages, and reads its login, username and API token from ~/.config/copr.
copr-cli 是 Copr 构建服务的命令行前端，用于创建项目、提交和监控构建、 管理 chroot 与软件包，并从 ~/.config/copr 读取登录名、用户名和 API token。
